name: Ballpark Scoreboard
description: Old hand-operated ballpark scoreboard: painted green boards with seams, black number tins, cream header boards, yellow ball / strike / out bulbs and slab numerals. A long scoreboard-strip scorebug and a full manual scoreboard with linescore, B-S-O lights and the AT BAT tin. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
